in_natural_bv32_cb.desc: Returns 1 if the input is within 0 to 127 (inclusive); otherwise returns 0.

get_hword_cb.desc: Returns the result of shifting the input left by 8 bits (i.e., multiplying by 256)..

get_lword_cb.desc: Returns the lower 8 bits of the input.

bvshl_int_cb.desc: Returns the result of shifting the first input left by the number of bits specified by the second input.

bvlshr_int_cb.desc: Returns the result of shifting the first input right by the number of bits specified by the second input.
